china-1916:p0125_6.rationale: Single-column list of cities where electric tramways operate or are under construction; the subject is tramway locations, confirmed as tram systems by the title Electric Tramways.

korea-1942:p0131_1.rationale: Counts of participants by sport at the 16th Korea Shrine Athletic Meet; entrant numbers rather than results, so sports-participation applies, with the sporting subject marked by the sport topic in the same record.

taiwan-tokei-1925:p0263_2.rationale: Light-railway (push-car track) operators with route length and handcar numbers by district, 1925. Track is described as 軌道 with handcars, so trams is confirmed only as a push-car line; the title mentions light railways, so railways is also included.
review_questions: The 軌道 system is not clearly a street or interurban tram; the trams tag is a tentative fit for a mixed light-railway inventory and may need confirmation.

japan-1937:p0409_1.rationale: Monthly index numbers spanning prices, export values, import quantities, industrial production, railway freights, bank clearings, note issue and stock quotations; a multi-domain economic barometer.

japan-1939-40:p0696_1.rationale: Governmental educational expenditure in yen by education category for 1936-37; a budget table for education.

korea-tokanfu-1939:p0246_1.rationale: Government-General special account revenue and expenditure by fiscal year, with ordinary and extraordinary sections; a public budget table.

manchuria-1939:p0091_1.rationale: Settlement groups of a railway self-protective village with year of settlement, households, members and cultivated area; the settler scheme and household counts are the subject.
review_questions: Whether the Manchukuo settlement scheme evidences foreign state-sponsored settlement sufficient for colonial-rule is a context judgement; colonial-rule is included cautiously.

far-east-1941:IMG_5400_1.rationale: Yearly production of rubber, tin ore and rice in Thailand; three commodities across mineral and crop categories. The rubber and tin series are primary products, and rice is a cereal, so the tags reflect the distinct commodity groups.
review_questions: Three commodities from different sectors are compared; the classification selects mineral-production and cereals as representatives, while rubber is not separately tagged.

nanyo-tokei-1937:p0041_3.rationale: Hunting licences issued by year and by branch office, across recreational, professional and scientific purposes; principally government licensing administration per the rules, with the police chapter context.

taiwan-tokei-1933:p0353_2.rationale: Licensed opium-related traders by category and by prefecture, 1928-1933; a licensing inventory organised by wholesalers, retailers and suppliers under the health chapter.
